blocks.html: Minimum specified concrete cover shall be provided for reinforcement in nonprestressed cast-in-place concrete construction in accordance with ACI 318, Section 20.6.1.3.1, but shall not be less than required by Sections 1907.7.6 and 1907.7.8 of this code.
